narrative.overview: Hash is an engineering-led technical consulting firm specializing in AI & agentic systems, distributed data engineering, full-stack platforms, and mobile apps. The visual language conveys quiet authority, cryptographic precision, and architectural resilience.
keyCharacteristics: Sovereign Monolith: 90–95% obsidian neutrals and dark slate surfaces.
Micro-Engineered Borders: Crisp 1px hairlines (rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)) that subtly illuminate on hover.
Single Sharp Accent: Pure technical cobalt (#1E6BFF), hue 255° in OKLCH, with zero purple/violet pollution.
Tabular Rigor: JetBrains Mono for system metrics, execution statuses, and technical metadata.
Symmetric Spatial Rhythm: Locked 1280px container, strict vertical flow, zero horizontal overflow.

rules.name: The 90/10 Neutral Supremacy Rule
rules.body: The visual canvas must maintain at least 90–95% obsidian and slate neutrals. The primary accent is restricted to under 10% of any viewport. Its rarity is the core of its authority.

rules.name: The Anti-Neon Doctrine
rules.body: Purple, violet, magenta, and multi-colored rainbow gradients are explicitly prohibited. Gradient text is restricted to high-contrast white-to-slate sweeps.

rules.name: The Tabular Precision Rule
rules.body: Every numeric figure, performance metric, latency readout, and timestamp must render in JetBrains Mono with tabular figures enabled.

rules.name: The Structural Hairline Rule
rules.body: Depth is communicated through contrasting surface tones (#08090B -> #0E1117 -> #151A22) coupled with 1px border highlights, never blurry drop shadows.

dos: Do maintain strict 90–95% obsidian neutral dominance on every screen.
Do enforce exact 44px height and 8px border-radius on all interactive buttons.
Do use JetBrains Mono with tabular figures for all metrics, numbers, and system readouts.
Do keep text line lengths between 50 and 68 characters for maximum legibility.
Do test viewports at 1440px and 390px to guarantee zero horizontal scroll.
donts: Don't introduce purple, violet, magenta, or neon rainbow gradients.
Don't use decorative stock 3D cartoons, floating isometric cubes, or generic AI iconography.
Don't use all-caps for headings or navigation links.
Don't set body copy below 16px or with contrast lower than 7:1 against its background.
Don't use multi-level dropdowns or bloated mega-menus.
